evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.922 Torr at the start of growth, in line with the ramp baseline of about 2.90 Torr.
Pressure rose every reading to 3.191 Torr, about 0.27 Torr (9%) in 720 s, while the flow setpoint stayed the same.
Argon flow held at about 100 sccm, so the flow controller is not raising the pressure.
Temperature is holding at 750 °C and heater power is steady at about 45%, so the thermal side looks normal.
No O2 sensor is installed, so the growth atmosphere cannot be checked, and a leak (O2 would rise) cannot be told apart from an exhaust blockage (O2 would stay flat).

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 or residual-gas reading, a leak-up test with the valves closed, or a check of how well the exhaust/pump line is conducting would separate a seal leak from an exhaust blockage.
